configurePresets.name: vs2019-x64
configurePresets.description: Visual Studio 16 2019 generator, x64, MSVC v142 (matches the ROS 2 Humble Windows distro). Reliable from any shell; build RelWithDebInfo. Ogre is found via QAR_ROS2_INSTALL_ROOT / ROS2_INSTALL_ROOT / CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH.

configurePresets.name: ninja-msvc-x64
configurePresets.displayName: Ninja + MSVC x64 RelWithDebInfo (fast; needs a VS dev shell)
configurePresets.description: Single-config Ninja build. Must be configured from a shell with the MSVC x64 environment loaded (vcvars64 / Developer PowerShell), otherwise the compiler is not found. Prefer vs2019-x64 for reliability.
